## sminer report

Print the ranked findings report

### Synopsis

Print the ranked findings report as Markdown, or JSON with --json.

Findings are ranked by occurrences × weight × repos. With --output, the report
is written to that file (atomically) and findings.json is written beside it.

```
sminer report [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  sminer report | less
  sminer report --output report.md
  sminer report --json > findings.json
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help            help for report
      --min-count int   occurrences a finding needs to be reported (default 3)
  -o, --output string   write the report to this file instead of stdout
      --repo string     only consider sessions in this repository
      --since string    how far back to look: 90d, 2w, 12h (default "90d")
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --config string   config file (default $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/sminer/config.yaml)
      --db string       database file (default $XDG_DATA_HOME/sminer/sminer.db)
      --json            print machine-readable JSON on stdout
      --no-color        disable color (also NO_COLOR=1)
      --offline         never call the network; heuristics and local clustering only
  -q, --quiet           print nothing on stderr except errors
  -v, --verbose         print detail on stderr
```
